# Business Simulator - Development Roadmap

 

This document outlines the planned development path for Business Simulator.

 

---

 

## 🎯 Vision

 

Create a comprehensive, engaging business simulation game that provides realistic and educational business management experiences across multiple industries.

 

---

 

## 📅 Development Phases

 

### **Phase 1: Core Stability & Polish** ✅ (Completed)

**Target: v0.1.0** | **Status: In Progress**

 

#### Completed ✅

- [x] Character & Company Creation Flow

- [x] Three business modes (Fintech, Insurance, Investment)

- [x] Time/Progression System

- [x] Save/Load System

- [x] Basic game balance and difficulty levels

 

#### In Progress 🚧

- [ ] Bug fixes and stability improvements

- [ ] Performance optimization

- [ ] Code quality improvements

 

---

## 🔧 Technical Roadmap

 

### Immediate (Next 2 Weeks)

- [ ] Add unit tests for core game logic

- [ ] Improve TypeScript type coverage

- [ ] Set up CI/CD pipeline

- [ ] Add error boundaries

- [ ] Performance profiling and optimization

 

### Short-term (1-2 Months)

- [ ] Implement proper logging system

- [ ] Add Sentry for error tracking

- [ ] Database integration for saves (MongoDB/PostgreSQL)

- [ ] API authentication for multiplayer prep

- [ ] SEO optimization

 

### Medium-term (3-6 Months)

- [ ] Migrate to dedicated backend (Express/NestJS)

- [ ] WebSocket for real-time features

- [ ] Redis caching for performance

- [ ] Implement analytics (Google Analytics/Mixpanel)

- [ ] A/B testing framework

 

### Long-term (6-12 Months)

- [ ] Microservices architecture

- [ ] Kubernetes deployment

- [ ] GraphQL API

- [ ] Progressive Web App (PWA)

- [ ] Native mobile apps (React Native)

## 📊 Metrics & Goals

 

### v0.1.0 Goals

- 🎯 Core gameplay loop functional

- 🎯 All 3 business modes playable

- 🎯 Save/load working reliably

- 🎯 Zero critical bugs

 

### v0.2.0 Goals

- 🎯 90%+ mobile responsiveness score

- 🎯 Tutorial completion rate > 80%

- 🎯 Average session time > 15 minutes

- 🎯 User retention (Day 7) > 40%

 

### v0.3.0 Goals

- 🎯 5+ playable business types

- 🎯 100+ hours of unique gameplay

- 🎯 Achievement system with 50+ achievements

 

### v1.0.0 Goals

- 🎯 10,000+ active players

- 🎯 4.5+ star average rating

- 🎯 Monthly active users (MAU) growth

- 🎯 Community engagement metrics
